# Fixtures

All files here are **synthetic test data written for this project**. They are not copies of real
feeds or real API responses. Domains use reserved names (`example.org`, `example.com`, `.test`).
They exist to exercise parsers and error handling deterministically, never to demonstrate real
popularity or trends.

- `rss/`, `atom/`: feed documents (valid, malformed, malicious).
- `hn/`: Hacker News API-shaped JSON (shape per https://github.com/HackerNews/API).
